modelSensitivity.source: Measured on the internal test split at the operating point frozen 2026-08-23: 0.9600 (95% Wilson CI 0.8889-0.9863, 72/75). results/20260823_211537_internal_test

modelSpecificity.source: Measured on the internal test split at the operating point frozen 2026-08-23: 0.9167 (95% Wilson CI 0.8492-0.9555, 99/108). results/20260823_211537_internal_test

deferralRate.source: Retained at 0.10 as a conservative planning value. Probability-gate escalation measured at 0.066 (internal test) and 0.076 (validation); those are LOWER bounds because grade.decisionPolicy also escalates on evidence, agreement and rule-engine conditions not simulable from probabilities alone. Full-pipeline measurement still outstanding.

referablePrevalence.source: Retained at 0.10 as a screening-population planning value. Deliberately NOT set to the 0.41 referable fraction of the APTOS test split: APTOS is a competition dataset enriched for disease, not a screening cohort, and using its prevalence would badly distort the workload model.
